title: Fix Design Tokens color examples to use a color-object $value
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Fix Design Tokens color examples to use a color-object $value
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L297: "a `\"$value\"` that is a Design Tokens color object with `colorSpace` and `components` members and optional `alpha` and `hex` members, not a CSS color string ... For example: `{\"$type\": \"color\", \"$value\": {\"colorSpace\": \"srgb\", \"components\": [0.345, 0.396, 0.949], \"hex\": \"#5865f2\"}}`"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:1342 (doc: `{"$type": "color", "$value": "..."}`); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space.rs:657 (test vector $value "oklch(0.7 0.15 250)"); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space_set.rs:537 (same test vector)
Now: The color type is raw serde_json::Value, so the wire behavior already preserves any representation. Only the client doc and two round-trip test vectors still show the now-invalid CSS-string $value form.
Change: Update the doc example and the test vectors to the spec's color-object example (oracle text changed). No type change is needed.
